_about: The one source for Vault Graph rule data. Read by vault_graph.py (Python) and embedded into vault_graph_rules.js by the build (graph page + plugin). Patterns must be valid in both Python re and JS RegExp. hub_name/not_map_name are case-insensitive. A map may live in 00-Inbox (where Create map writes it). context_suffix: a '<Topic> - Context' note is also named by its topic in prose (mentions). mention_stop: titles too generic to count as a mention in prose. root_hubs: the notes at the vault's top level that are dashboards (hubs, not topic notes). trophic_*: food-web levels are by rank of out-share (cuts = share of linked notes below each level); notes with fewer links than trophic_min_degree stay off the bottom and top levels. provisional_tops: notes there join the graph once a topic note links to them (a note created for a wanted link); reports and exports there stay out. provisional_skip_tags: provisional notes with these tags (vault maintenance, reports) never join. folders: this vault's folder names (reports: where automated reports go, out of the inbox), read by every part (analysis, graph, plugin, actions); another vault changes them here (and the folder names in not_map_tops / provisional_tops). files: the content log (each note's last content change) lives in the plugin folder, whose name is the plugin's id (jk-vault-graph: a published plugin is called vault-graph, and Obsidian swapped this one for it); out of recent-files lists; each analysis run copies it to content_backup, which the plugin and the analysis read when a plugin reinstall has removed the folder. recall: the recall search's tuning (boosts for a match in the name, heading or code; journals and link lists ranked lower; synonyms; stop words), read by _System/vault_recall.py and the plugin's VGRules.recall.

folders._about_exclude: Never analysed or scanned (a folder managed somewhere else). scripts/system/templates: the vault's tooling folders, left out of link suggestions and of re-analysis on edit.
folders._about_cache: Generated files only this PC needs (the graph page, screenshots, the search index, test output). A dot-folder, so Obsidian Sync leaves it out; _scripts/out keeps only what the phone reads (vault-graph.json).

files._about: data: the analysis output every device reads (synced); analysis: the script the desktop plugin runs; dismissed / shared: the plugin's synced state (dismissed pairs; review, quests and saved views).

cues._about: How people describe what they half-remember. kinds: a word in the query that names the kind of thing prefers chunks of that kind (code in those languages, tables, task lists, images, errors). time: phrases that set a date range (soft: in range ranks higher). people come from the people folder. The cue words still count as words. Each kind's text pattern is tested line by line, case-insensitive, by both engines. usage_boost: notes you rely on (links in, opens) rank a little higher among near-equal hits. near_words: 'near <note name>' boosts notes linked to that note. related: how many notes similar in meaning to the top hits follow them (the analysis's 'similar' links).
